<function name="GetBodygroupCount" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>
		Returns the number of <page text="Sub Models">Entity:GetSubModels</page> in the Body Group corresponding to a given <page text="Body Group ID">Structures/BodyGroupData#id</page> of the <page text="Entity's">Entity</page> model.
		<note>
			Weapons will return results from their viewmodels.
		</note>
</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="bodyGroupId" type="number">
			The Body Group ID to retrieve the Sub Model count of.  
			Body Group IDs start at `0`.
		</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">
			The number of Sub Models in the Body Group.
		</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
